text:
The male cuckoo, whose throat is tinged with the astringent taste of the chuta sapling, uttered a sweet song. That very utterance, born of a mind skilled in unimpeded eloquence, is remembered by me.

Due to the departure of the snow, the lips of the women became vividly red, and their facial complexion turned yellowish. The exudation of sweat began to settle upon the specific leaves of the men and women.
